submission.natural_language_explanation: This negative pole is the GELU trough of layer-2 neuron 1021 rather than a detector of its own: its strength is max(0, -gelu_new(pre-activation)), hard-capped at the gelu_new global minimum 0.1700408, so any pre-activation in about [-0.95, -0.60] reads within a few percent of that floor - all 20 top examples are float32 ties at 0.1700408 whose peak tokens (' Ave', ' 24', ' in', ' bass', ' own', 'retion', 'SS', 'https', 'atur', 'a', 'wide', 'aimed', 'note', 'on', 'rief', '2', 'ant', ' May', 'y') share nothing but a pre-activation near -0.75, about 3-4% of tokens sit within 3% of the floor and a fifth of 128-token windows land within 1e-4 of it, and the cap is a property of the layer (3,049 of 3,072 L2 neurons reach it on 12k tokens) while the neuron itself is alive (its positive pole peaks at 1.377 and the trough occupies only 38% of tokens); it is retrospective, not lookahead (Jacobian-lens kurtosis 3.0 with 0% lens overlap, and next-token identity predicts the scalar no better than chance). Label 'predicted active' (0.5-1.0 of scale) for a prompt in which a measured token's pre-activation lands in the trough band - a determiner, preposition, month, four-digit year or reflexive pronoun in a content slot (' the table' 0.97, ' a letter' 0.99, ' of course' 1.00, ' in fact' 1.00, ' by the way' 0.99, ' March 2018' 0.97, ' Sanders by' 1.00, ' himself too' 0.69) - or any run of 12+ tokens of ordinary prose in any domain (96% of 12-token, 98% of 16-token and 99% of 32-token held-out Pile windows active; six measured prompts 0.54-1.00), and label 'predicted inactive' (below 0.25 of scale = 0.042; every one measured at exactly 0.000) for a one-token prompt of any token (200 random tokens all read 0.000, because position 0 always pushes the pre-activation positive) and for a 2-4 token prompt whose measured tokens are all words of the neuron's positive side - word-initial open-class tokens: proper names and team or brand names (' Sanders', ' Trump', ' Corbyn', ' Christie', ' Walker', ' Rebecca', ' Kings', ' Clippers', ' Warriors', ' Motorola', ' Samsung', ' Adobe'), technical nouns and adjectives (' optical', ' impedance', ' battery', ' motor', ' auxiliary', ' prototype') and the measured content words (' candidates', ' voters', ' subjects', ' selected', ' select', ' values', ' data', ' image', ' some', ' do', ' know', ' museum', ' campaign', ' primary') - 31 such prompts ('Sanders Trump', 'optical impedance', 'some values', 'the museum', 'select values data image') all at 0.000, though inserting a preposition before such a word can still drop it into the trough (' in data' 0.52).
